title: Industry Story Translator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners adapt one story template for healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing by choosing industry language, the challenge that industry measures, and its regulatory reference.

learningObjectives: Adapt a base story for different industries by selecting industry-specific language, challenges, and regulatory references.

keyQuestions: Adapt a base story for different industries by selecting industry-specific language, challenges, and regulatory references.
commonMisconceptions: The same story works across industries.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct language, challenge, and regulation for all three industries.
Learner can explain why SOX and GDPR are wrong for the healthcare story.
